min_cap: minimum operable capacity [% of total capacity]
newfac_ref_cap: capacity of reference facility for new vintages [metric tons/yr]
cost_cap: capital cost = installed + direct + indirect + land costs [$2020/(dry metric ton feedstock/day)]
cost_vom: variable operations and maintenance cost (excludes all energy--power and heat--and feedstocks costs) [$2020/MMBtu]
int_h2_mark: Market purchased hydrogen intensity of process [lb-H2/MMBtu-fuel-produced]
int_h2_self: Self produced hydrogen intensity of process [lb-H2/MMBtu-fuel-produced]
int_co2_mark: market purchased input CO2  intensity of process [metric tons CO2/MMBtu-fuel-produced]
int_co2_self: self-generated input CO2 intensity of process [metric tons CO2/MMBtu-fuel-produced]
int_met_coal_feed: metallurgical coal intensity [MMBtu MCL/MMBtu fuel produced]
int_ddfo: diesel and distillate fuel oil intensity [MMBtu DDFO/MMBtu fuel produced]
co2_rate_comb: carbon emission intensity of combustion of biomass and non-tracked fuels [lb-CO2/MMBtu-fuel-produced]
ccs_cap_rate_proc: share of process emissions captured through CCS [%]
ccs_cap_rate_comb: share of feedstock and fuels combustion emissions captured through CCS [%]
